description: Player prop history across recent games for one market. Returns each prior prop this player took with line, prices, resolution, actual value, is_main_line (the book's main line vs an alt-ladder rung) and line_moved_in_play. Pass main_line_only=true to drop alt rungs. Pro tier returns full data; free tier returns redacted resolution/actual_value with an upgrade pointer.

limit.description: Max number of past games (default 20, max 100)

main_line_only.description: Only each book's main line (drops alt-ladder rungs). Omit for every line.

markets.description: Deprecated alias: the first market of a comma-separated list is used when `market` is omitted

player_name.description: Player name as it appears in box scores — e.g. 'Aaron Judge', 'Nikola Jokic' — or a player_id from propline_search_players, e.g. 'mlb:592450'

name: propline_get_player_history
title: Get player prop history
